items.text: This is less a game and more an interactive story. It has weak gameplay, but mostly makes up with good writing; I did have a monstrous complaint though: there is no divergence, and so it has zero replayability.  I felt pushed onto a trail I didn't want to be on; in a book that's fine and dandy, but video games I play to have some semblence of control. This had next to none.
items.text_zh: 这与其说是游戏，不如说是一个互动故事。它的玩法很弱，但主要靠出色的文笔弥补；不过我有一个巨大的抱怨：没有任何分歧，因此它完全没有重玩价值。我感觉自己被推上了一条我不想走的路；在一本书里这没什么问题，但我玩电子游戏是为了获得某种控制感。这个游戏几乎没有。

observations.description: 剧情没有分支，缺乏重玩价值
observations.evidence: there is no divergence, and so it has zero replayability
observations.evidence_zh: 没有任何分歧，所以它完全没有重玩价值。

items.text: "F" Game.  Amounts to an hour of you controlling absolutely trivial actions, you are the insignificant twitch in a losers hand. Nothing you do matters to the "on rails" progression, every playthrough is the same, and the "story" is just the dull ramblings of a frustrated loner.  Not what I imagined from the description.  I love "story style" games and I still say Pass.
items.text_zh: “F”级游戏。充其量就是一个小时里你控制着极其琐碎的动作，你只是一个失败者手中微不足道的抽搐。你所做的一切对“轨道式”的进程毫无影响，每次游玩都是一样的，而“故事”只是一个沮丧的孤独者无聊的絮叨。不是我从描述中想象的那样。我喜欢“故事风格”的游戏，但我还是说：跳过。

observations.description: 进程完全固定，每次游玩都一样
observations.evidence: the "on rails" progression, every playthrough is the same
observations.evidence_zh: “线性轨道式”的推进，每一次通关都一模一样
